Telephone Manager Initialization Functions / Passing Events to a Telephone Tool for Processing

TELResume

Processes a resume or suspend event for a window associated with the telephone tool. 
pascal void TELResume (TELHandle hTEL, Boolean resume);
hTEL
A handle to the telephone record associated with a telephone terminal.
resume
A value that determines whether a resume or suspend event is processed. If the value is true, the telephone tool processes a resume event. If the value is not true, the telephone tool processes a suspend event.
DESCRIPTION
The TELResume function processes a suspend or resume event for telephone tools that have a custom menu to install or remove from the menu bar.
